coordinate_system: Zero-based [x, y]; origin at top-left; x increases right, y increases down.
provenance: Original small teaching layouts authored for this A01 package; no reference-game maps copied.

levels.name: First Steps
levels.teaches: Push one crate in a straight line.

levels.name: Around the Bend
levels.teaches: Walk around a crate to change the push direction.

levels.name: Two Deliveries
levels.teaches: Plan a route between two crates.

levels.name: Three Clearings
levels.teaches: Reposition three crates around two obstacles.
